---
name: Spike
about: Time-boxed research task for architecture, schema, or workflow decisions
title: "SPIKE: "
labels: ["type:spike"]
assignees: []
---

## Question

What needs to be answered?

## Why This Matters

Explain the delivery risk or decision this spike unblocks.

## Scope

List what is in scope and out of scope for the investigation.

## Reserved Paths

If the spike includes code experiments, list the path prefixes it may touch. Otherwise write `none`.

## Deliverable

State what the spike must produce.

Example:

- decision note
- schema proposal
- API contract proposal

## Time Box

State the maximum time or effort.

## Done Definition

- [ ] Research output posted on the issue
- [ ] Recommendation is explicit
- [ ] Follow-up story or epic is linked
